question.text:
To find the focal length of a convex mirror, a student records the following data:
Object pin Convex Lens Convex Mirror Image Pin
22.2 cm 32.2 cm 45.8 cm 71.2 cm
The focal length of the convex lens is f1 and that of mirror is f2 . Then taking index correction to be negligibly small, f1 and f2 are close to:

options.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>7.8</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>12.7</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>

<math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>12.7</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>    <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>7.8</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>

<math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>15.6</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>    <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>25.4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>

<math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>7.8</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>    <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">f</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>25.4</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">c</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math>

solution.text:
Take f2=12.7

1f=1v+1u

112.7=125.4+1u

112.7=125.4=1u

u=25.4=v′

1f=1v-1u

1f1=125.4+13.6+110

1f1=139+110

1f1=39049=7.96

The closest answers is (1) as option (3) and (4) are not possible.
